note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: The four blog/LinkedIn displays entering the lock (cinatra#3033, lifecycle-c W9) carried over main. MEASURED, NOT ARGUED, on the merge commit's own tree by scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline with the companion extension fleet cloned PINNED at the merged lock (node scripts/ci/sync-dev-extensions.mjs --pinned, 116/116), exactly as CI measures. The raise is the SUM OF TWO ADDITIVE GROWTHS that had not met before this forward: this branch's own, committed against the merge-base c91236d1c118 (/api/mcp 1768 -> 1794, /chat 1870 -> 1897, /api/a2a 1776 -> 1802, /api/llm-bridge 1786 -> 1812), and main's own over the same base (+21 on each of the four), which main committed with its own absorb records. Neither side's growth is folded into the other's: the merged counts land within one module of base + this branch's delta + main's delta on every tracked route, which is what an additive union of two disjoint edge sets reads as. This branch's edges are the four extension packages' renderer registrations entering the generated display map (src/lib/generated/artifact-renderers.ts, regenerated here through scripts/extensions/generate-extension-manifest.mjs): blog-idea, blog-image, blog-post and linkedin-artifacts, nine guarded-optional renderer entries in all. The growth is ADDITIVE: no module leaves any route's reachable set. NARROWING IS UNAVAILABLE here — the display map is reachable from all four routes by construction and route-graph.mjs counts a dynamic import() specifier as the same graph pressure as a static one, so deferring the entries would not lower the count. /sign-in reaches none of it and KEEPS main's committed ceiling untouched. The records main carries for these four routes are RETIRED BY THIS RAISE, the one lifecycle the gate allows for an annotation whose ceiling moves.
